name: Aisa no Namida
source:
Hero and his six friends come to play to a solitary island. There they meet a girl named Lara. She and other local girls get to sing traditional songs which are a key to the mystery of the island and to the legend of a sleeping mermaid.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄和他的六个朋友来到一个孤岛玩耍。在那里他们遇到了一个名叫劳拉的女孩。她和其他当地女孩会唱传统歌曲，这些歌曲是解开岛屿之谜和沉睡美人鱼传说的关键。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
